sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Aman Usman, AP  SI Manisha, P.S. G  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 16.11.2023 CRL.M.A. 31287/2023(Exemption)
1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is accordingly disposed of.

3. This is the second bail application on behalf of the applicant seeking regular bail in case FIR No.
170/2021 under Sections 376 of the IPC and Sections 6/21 of the POCSO Act, registered at P.S.
Greater Kailash-1,
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file a status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing.

6. List on 12.12.2023.
7. Notice be issued to the complainant/respondent no.2, through the SHO concerned, returnable on the date already fixed.
This is a digitally signed order.
